en.hubeali: H 14723 – Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washaa, from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said that:

‘The people are of three levels – A level who are from us<sup>asws</sup> and we<sup>asws</sup> are from them; and a level who adorn themselves by us<sup>asws</sup> (our<sup>asws</sup> name); and a level who eat each other by us<sup>asws</sup> (our<sup>asws</sup> name)’.
en.sarwar: 275. Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Mu‘alla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washaa, from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that:

‘The people are of three levels – A level who are from us (a.s.) and we (a.s.) are from them; and a level who adorn themselves by us (a.s.) (our (a.s.) name); and a level who eat each other by us (a.s.) (our (a.s.) name)’.
